newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Innerhadden bids for CP Ventures.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Innerhadden bids for CP Ventures.

text.p: Innerhadden Ltd said on Monday it plans to offer to buy out the rest of the shares did does not already own in fellow investment group CP Ventures Ltd for 78 cents per share.
Innerhadden, which owns 86 percent of CP Ventures, said it would also offer 3.895 cents for each CP Ventures managers shares.
CP has 38.84 million ordinary shares on issue.
The offers will be conditional on Innerhadden acquiring sufficient shares to move to compulsory acquisition of all ordinary shares and acquiring 100 percent of the managers shares.
CP Ventures shares last traded at 69 cents on October 30.
